acceptanceCriteria: Each new mechanical reason is recomputed by the LLM-free verifier from the two blob hashes alone; a hunk it cannot reproduce is refused, not accepted.
Fixtures cover a true positive and a near-miss for each class so semantic changes hidden inside a reorder are not classified mechanical.
CEM version and the reason vocabulary are bumped additively with the spec updated in the same change.
body: Owner requested the 2026-09 state-of-the-art gap review items as part of Corvint 0.7.0 on 2026-09-22. This ticket records release intent, not delivery or promotion. Original Go implementation; extend the cited existing mechanisms and preserve the existing public wires. Before implementation is called complete, update the owning indexed spec with stable requirements, non-goals, failure modes, acceptance evidence and rollback, and finish normal CEM/OCM, independent review and mandatory gates. Current state: CEM 0.1 mechanical reasons are only `whitespace-only` and `line-ending-only`. Add structural-diff classification for rename, move, import reorder and formatter-only hunks (Go first, via go/ast or gofmt normalization), emitting a mechanical reason that the verifier can check without an LLM. Prior art: RefactoringMiner, GumTree, Mergiraf. Owning spec: docs/CHANGE-EVIDENCE-MAP.md.
